minimumAtIntervalStart.testOnlyMappingPremise: For this branch only, the fixture's one real imported food unit is identified as one Player Rulebook v6 Rations (1 day) item (2 lb).

For this branch only, the fixture's one real imported water-container unit is identified as one Player Rulebook v6 Waterskin, full (5 lb). The current generic fixture label alone does not prove this mapping.

proposedSupplyContract.sufficiencyRule: At worldElapsedSeconds 1.0, A's actual availability, ownership, and custody of the listed one-day ration and one full waterskin satisfy Q26's real-supplies prerequisite for this one 3600-second TEST_ONLY rest interval. These quantities are sufficient by this scoped rule; the Fortress contributes none of them.
proposedSupplyContract.consumptionRule: No food or water consumption is required for eligibility or completion of this one-hour TEST_ONLY short rest. This contract does not assert consumption. P368's eating/drinking activity permission remains activity classification only. Any actual consumption, if separately introduced in a future proposal, must be explicitly recorded and deducted from the real inventory; it is not implied here.
proposedSupplyContract.custodyRule: A remains the real owner/custodian of both imported items throughout the recorded interval. The source fixture's unchanged custody and quantity-preservation transitions govern; no item is created, copied, replenished, or transferred by this contract.
proposedSupplyContract.durationAndSafety: P368-BINDING eligibility is established by review 377. Safety for this declared interval is established by Director review 379 only. This supply contract adds no duration, activity, interruption, or safety rule.
proposedSupplyContract.recoveryAndBenefits: No RP formula, recovery cap, Dissonance rule, rest counter, or other benefit is added or modified. Any benefit still requires a separate reviewed, reversible completion/settlement proposal and applicable recovery-limit checks.
